items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: Well we had George Fucci, playing bass, Israel, Lionel, Herman Antwine, and Albert Giles.

ctx.x: Well when Israel had it first, who was it?
Well we had George Fucci, playing bass, Israel, Lionel, Herman Antwine, and Albert Giles.
Herman Antwine was a guitar player, did he have a trombone?
